project: Yes, indeed. It is called Loafric, where the transitory countertops of the Loafs of Ginger converge. In venturing right, the food stuffs discover the truth of the old words. “The fire fades and the bakers go without ovens. When the link of toaster is threatened, the kitchen bell tolls, unearthing the old Loafs of Ginger from their pantries."
Leader of the Kitchen Cult, Crackroll.
And the horrid loaf commander of the Organization, Dreadroll.
The bakers will abandon their ovens, and the Unbuttered will rise.
Nameless, accursed unbread, unfit even to be fully baked.
Disembodied Voice: So you are the unbuttered one, legend of the kitchen, the only one who had the audacity to revolt against the baker...
Disembodied Voice: Your rebellion sparked something within him. The will and the power to create even more life from the ovens. Ahead is one of his greatest creations... Goodbutters.
Disembodied Voice: Yummy Yummy apple, you should eat to mend thy wounds.
Disembodied Voice: Here is an explosive lemon. It explodes and is a lemon. I absolutely think it will be very beneficial.
Disembodied Voice: Beware, traveler. There is a dastardly BreadRoll ahead. Its outer shell is hard enough to survive those little tootsies of yours.

Disembodied Voice: You must pick up this very sharp sword, for your hands alone will not suffice when facing vile threats and hordes of viscous foes. You must think like the wind and slice with the elegance of a beautiful dancer.
